narrative: On the part. The tiring-house side of the door, his cue-strip in his hand, the yard already in. No face. No second man's name on the strip. On the part. The same strip, turned down. He is off the stage. The play goes on without a mark of his.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Opened as Egeon, and was idle after.

entities.name: The Comedy of Errors
entities.context: Shown on part in Egeon, then idle
